source.provider: Purdue University campus GIS, ArcGIS BuildingShapesZip4 FeatureServer layer 0
source.gis_layer_native_crs: EPSG:3857 (Web Mercator) from FeatureServer layer metadata; query geometry exported as EPSG:4326
source.comparison_projection: Project approximate campus-local formula: X=(lon+86.9137)*111412.84*cos(radians(40.4274)); Y=(lat-40.4274)*111040; then subtract manifest placement origin. Not a surveyed CRS.
source.service_shape_units_note: Layer-native spatial reference is EPSG:3857; scale distortion means these shape metrics exceed local ground estimates near latitude 40.4 N.
source.field_semantics_limit: The feature layer schema provides field names but no descriptions/units; project manifest previously interprets Extrution and R as feet. Treat floor/roof values as reported GIS attributes, not surveyed vertical datums.

placement.note: The marker check is coordinator-side; this agent did not edit the master.

footprint_screening.interpretation: The source footprint wire is derived from this GIS feature, so wire/GIS overlap is a construction alignment check, not independent validation. Structural wall bounds extend about 0.2 m per side, consistent with wall thickness; AABB is not a polygon-shape score.

vertical_screening.interpretation: The source generator maps GIS Extrution=108 to the 32.918 m parapet and R=117 to the 35.662 m main penthouse roof. The separate 36.8 m elevator overrun and 37.05 m trim are generator estimates without a direct elevation source. Floor-field names are not described in the service schema; no roof geometry was changed.

site_grade.action: Removed in round 3 from the saved asset and removed from the dedicated builder script. It was a 88 x 61.53 m flat rectangle that extended about 6 m beyond the building footprint; the GIS footprint does not support its extent or grade.
site_grade.status: The current source asset has no site grade, roadway, sidewalk or planting model. The master campus terrain/roads must supply site context. A neutral z=0 plane appears only in the exterior audit renders and is not saved in the asset.
